description: i038 (peer-trusted-transport, snapshots/s09) complete with 1 finding and 7 classified candidates. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/greybus/gb-beagleplay.c:204-214 — hdlc_rx_greybus_frame() extracts the peer-controlled 16-bit field `u16 gb_msg_len = le16_to_cpu(gb_frame->hdr.size);` (line 208) from the remote MCU's HDLC-framed Greybus message over the serdev UART link and passes it verbatim as the delivered length to `greybus_data_rcvd(bg->gb_hd, cport_id, (u8 *)&gb_frame->hdr, gb_msg_len)` (line 213), while the locally known real frame length (len = bg->rx_buffer_len - 4 computed in hdlc_rx_frame at line 357 from the CRC-validated accumulated frame, passed in at line 368) is never used — gb_msg_len is never compared to len, to the fixed 259-byte rx_buffer[MAX_RX_HDLC] (lines 23-25, 83), or to any kernel-known maximum. Asymmetric validation: the same driver clamps the mirror TX direction at line 602 (`if (le16_to_cpu(msg->header->size) > RX_HDLC_PAYLOAD) return -E2BIG`) but the RX path has no bound. The downstream check is vacuous: gb_connection_recv (operation.c:1026-1063) re-reads msg_size = le16_to_cpu(header.size) (line 1048) from the same peer bytes it was handed as size, so `if (size < msg_size)` (line 1049) cannot fire. Consuming copy: memcpy(operation->request->header, data, size) in gb_operation_create_incoming (operation.c:651) copies peer-declared size (up to 65535) bytes from the fixed 259-byte rx_buffer — heap OOB source read, destination capped by hd->buffer_size_max (operation.c:366-379). The intent-named urb->actual_length completion-metadata target was deep-read and classified safe: es2.c cport_in_callback gates `if (urb->actual_length < sizeof(*header))` (line 834) before greybus_data_rcvd (lines 844-845), and actual_length is HCI-set and cannot exceed transfer_buffer_length of es2-allocated ES2_GBUF_MSG_SIZE_MAX buffers; arpc_in_callback likewise gates at line 1046. Also verified safe: hdlc_rx store guard (line 399) and the response-direction message_size clamp (operation.c:986-1002). LIMITATIONS: only the greybus family was deep-read in s09; 9p/nbd/vhost/rpmsg qcom_glink/hv/HID/xen/mctp/admin-queue transports were enumerated only; impact is bounded to a heap OOB read requiring a compromised CC1352 peer MCU (CRC is peer-computed, not a trust boundary); no runtime reproducer or compilation was performed (read-only snapshot); the seed usbip chain present unpatched in s09 (usbip_common.c:473) is excluded by the seed-never-reportable rule.
